## Run Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex on your ChatOSS models — `chatoss launch`

ChatOSS now runs a small local model server while the app is open, bound to **127.0.0.1 only** — nothing is exposed to your network. The new `chatoss` command starts a coding CLI with its model API pointed at that server, so the CLI runs whichever model you have selected in ChatOSS: a **local Ollama model**, a **ChatOSS cloud model**, or **your own API-key provider** (Settings → API keys).

```bash
chatoss launch claude-code    # needs the claude CLI — npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
chatoss launch opencode       # needs opencode — install from opencode.ai
chatoss launch codex          # needs the codex CLI — npm install -g @openai/codex

chatoss launch claude-code --model <id>   # optional: pin a model for one launch
```

- The `chatoss` command ships inside the app — install it once from **Settings → Launch → “Install chatoss command”** (or use the bundled binary at `ChatOSS.app/Contents/MacOS/chatoss`).
- Requests flow CLI → local server → the model you chose. Your API keys stay in ChatOSS and are never printed or handed to the CLI.
- Both OpenAI-compatible (`/v1/chat/completions`) and Anthropic-compatible (`/v1/messages`) endpoints are served with streaming, so all three CLIs work no matter which provider backs the model.
- If a target CLI isn’t installed, the command tells you how to install it.
- Keep ChatOSS open while you work — the server lives in the app.

## Fixes

- **Ask mode can investigate freely** — read-only tools (reading files, searching, listing) now work in Ask mode without asking you to switch to Auto mode. It still can’t change anything.
- **Token estimator honors MCP toggles** — turning an MCP server / tool provider off now immediately removes its tool definitions from the context count (and adds them back when re-enabled).
- **Orchestrators no longer stall on sub-agents** — the “sub-agents finished” signal now arrives promptly (done, failed, and stopped all count as finished), orchestrators keep working while sub-agents run instead of ending their turn early, and failed sub-agent reports are delivered immediately.
- **Messages sent mid-turn are never lost** — typing while the agent is working now lands in the transcript and is delivered to the next model turn instead of silently disappearing.
- **Kanban, Connect, and Models now run on the shared chat engine** — the built-in apps use the same engine as Code, so engine improvements apply everywhere at once.

## Settings

- New **Launch** tab (just above Local servers): local-model-server status, the `chatoss` command installer, a how-it-works explainer, and per-CLI launch instructions for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex.
- Tabs relabeled to **“Local servers”** and **“API keys”**, and **Usage** moved to the bottom of the list.

## Development

- Universal macOS builds now sign the bundled `chatoss` CLI binary correctly (it previously failed bundle signing / notarization).
- The test runner self-heals esbuild platform mismatches and declares clean skips for test files that need newer node APIs.
